STATES: u0, u1, u2
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES: u2

(u0, at_exit & !siren_ringing) -> u2
(u0, else) -> u0
(u1, switch_toggled) -> u0
(u1, else) -> u1
(u2, else) -> u2
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u1, switch_toggled, u0) -> 0.1
(u0, at_exit & !siren_ringing, u2) -> 1.0
feedback: Accepted. Format is complete and matches the required layout: REWARD_MACHINE header, declared STATES u0-u2, INITIAL_STATE u0, and a nonempty FINAL_STATES (u2) that is declared and is the genuine accepting condition (exit reached with the siren silent). Semantic fidelity is correct: u0 holds exactly while the siren is silent, u1 exactly while it rings, and the only edge into u2 is guarded by at_exit & !siren_ringing, mirroring the environment's payment condition; each ring-silence cycle earns exactly one 0.1, matching 'each time the siren rings, switch it off'. The persistent/event split is right: the silencing guard uses the event switch_toggled, which is necessary because siren_ringing is already false after a silencing toggle, so a persistent guard could not express 'toggle while it was ringing'; ring detection uses persistent siren_ringing, and u1's else self-loop absorbs its persistence without re-triggering. Ordered coverage is safe: the two u0 guards are mutually exclusive, and the same-step case where the siren starts after the agent's toggle (action applies before due events) correctly routes to u1 without rewarding the wasted pre-ring toggle, with the still-ringing siren re-detected on the next step via the persistent guard, so the second cycle still pays its 0.1. Per-state else self-loops cover all irrelevant events (box events, silent toggles, at_exit while ringing, and post-terminal steps in u2). All states are reachable, and the regression u1->u0 is explicit, enabling the second ring cycle. Reward safety: nonnegative, bounded (at most two rings per episode, so at most 0.2 progress plus 1.0 final), and unfarmable since entering u1 requires an exogenous ring and silent toggles score 0 in u0. The flat 1.0 final is the correct constant stand-in for the time-shaped 1-0.9*frac environment payoff while preserving the success condition; if the setup lacks the siren the machine degenerates gracefully to the plain exit task.
